text:
alex: DeployBot flagged missing provenance for the SBOM on release v2.9.3-candidate. Also a low/medium transitive CVE (CVE-2026-1234) surfaced in a test helper. Missing signing metadata on the SBOM — do we pin, delay, or proceed with additional evidence?

devops-bot: DeployBot scan results:
```
Gate: SBOM_PROVENANCE_MISSING
Artifact: service-api:v2.9.3-candidate
Detected: third-party-manifest.json (no cosign signature)
Transitive CVE: CVE-2026-1234 (pkg:test-helper, severity: medium, runtime_exposure: false)
Required actions: attach_provenance OR legal_approval
```

maya: On it. Pinged build-artifacts team — where did the build run (region/runner)?

jamal: Staging build: sha256:abc123def456..., ran in eu-west-1 on ci-runner-42. I can fetch the artifact and try a local `cosign attach` but that will require a rebuild for hosted key attach.

legal-team: Legal: we need provenance evidence for audit. If we can't attach cosign with the canonical key, we can accept: recorded build logs + checksums + signed approval as a temporary mitigation, but only timeboxed (48h) and not for enterprise regulated customers.

qa-sre: QA: the CVE is in a test-only helper, no runtime exposure in prod. From a safety POV we can continue with a controlled canary if legal signs off.

alex: Change window closes in ~2h. Options: A) delay and attach cosign (risk missing window), B) proceed with scoped public canary + mitigation + release note caveat, C) pin transitive dep and rebuild. Thoughts?

maya: I can trigger cosign attach now if we have KMS access to the signing key. @jamal do you have access?

jamal: Not for the enterprise plugin — its key is in customer-managed KMS. For public builds we have a temporary hosted key, but CI attach requires a rebuild. We could also sign the SBOM with our internal key and mark provenance mismatch.

legal-team: We cannot accept internal-key signatures for enterprise customers. For public releases we can accept documented build trace as a short-term exception. Which parts of this release are enterprise-only?

alex: The enterprise-only plugin (plugin-enterprise) is bundled in the same pipeline but can be split. Proposal: carve out the enterprise plugin (hold it) and deploy the public API as a partial rollout.

devops-bot: DeployBot: initiating canary for release v2.9.3 -> canary-group A (10% traffic). Gate: SBOM_PROVENANCE_MISSING (severity: medium) Awaiting legal approval or evidence attach.

maya: Partial rollout sounds good. I'll start canary for public endpoints now. Jamal — please hold packaging for plugin-enterprise and open a change-window extension.

jamal: Filed change request CHG-4829 to extend change window + hold enterprise artifact. Re-running SBOM generation locally with `sbomgen --attach-cosign` and will push updated artifacts in ~40m.

alex: If we do canary, include a feature-flag toggle and an immediate rollback plan in release notes. Also add a short CVE note: no runtime exposure.

legal-team: Approve partial public canary under conditions:
- enterprise plugin artifact held (CHG-4829)
- compliance evidence (logs/checksums) uploaded to ticket within 48h
- release notes must include provenance caveat
:white_check_mark:

qa-sre: I'll watch canary metrics. Alerting thresholds: p95 latency +20% or error rate (5xx) > 0.5% -> kill canary.

alex: @devops-bot please annotate release metadata: `partial-rollout:true`, `enterprise-plugin:held`, `sbom-evidence-ticket:CHG-4829`.

devops-bot: Annotating release metadata... done.

maya: Pushed canary artifact tag sha:abc123. Attempting hosted cosign attach now, will report results.

jamal: CI cosign attach failed for enterprise plugin due to missing KMS access. Local attach for public artifact succeeded but won't satisfy enterprise compliance. Holding enterprise artifact.

alex: Summary/next steps: public API canary running; enterprise plugin held. Jamal to provide evidence in CHG-4829 within 48h or we roll back the enterprise plugin. Maya/QA watch metrics and be ready to abort. I'll update the release notes draft with the caveat and CVE explanation.

legal-team: Acknowledged. We'll re-evaluate once CHG-4829 has evidence. If not resolved in 48h, require rollback for enterprise plugin.

qa-sre: Monitoring in place, will report anomalies in #incidents if thresholds hit.

alex: Thanks all. :pray:
